        "text": "Ah, I understand perfectly now! You are talking strictly about"
      }, {
        "text": " the **art technique** itself—that heavy, stylized look with thick black ink outlines, flat colors, and hard shadows"
      }, {
        "text": " (like the art style in the *Borderlands* games, *Zelda*, or classic 90s anime"
      }, {
        "text": "). \n\nSince Nano Banana responds really well to descriptive"
      }, {
        "text": " art terms, you have to emphasize those specific \"cartoonish black lines\" to stop it from just making it look like a regular soft painting"
      }, {
        "text": ". \n\nHere are the updated prompts tailored for Nano Banana that heavily force that exact aesthetic onto"
      }, {
        "text": " the clothes and the new cape:\n\n### Option 1: The \"Brush/Masking\" Prompt (Best for Nano Banana\u0027"
      }, {
        "text": "s editor)\nIf you highlight/mask your clothes and the area for the cape, upload your context image, and use this prompt"
      }, {
        "text": ":\n\n\u003e **\"Add the cape from the context image onto the subject\u0027s back. Transform the masked clothing and the newly"
      }, {
        "text": " added cape into a 100% 2D cel-shaded art style. You must use thick, heavy,"
      }, {
        "text": " cartoonish black ink outlines around every edge, fold, and detail of the fabric. Use flat color blocking and sharp, hard-"
      }, {
        "text": "edged shadows with absolutely no gradients. The clothes and cape should look like a classic 2D comic book or anime drawing, while keeping the"
      }, {
        "text": " unmasked face and background perfectly photorealistic and untouched.\"**\n\n### Option 2: The Conversational Prompt (If"
      }, {
        "text": " uploading both images at once)\nIf you are just dropping both images into the chat and asking Nano Banana"
      }, {
        "text": " to combine them:\n\n\u003e **\"Keep the background and the subject\u0027s face entirely original and untouched. Take"
      }, {
        "text": " the cape from the reference image and place it on the subject. Now, apply an aggressive cel-shading effect ONLY"
      }, {
        "text": " to the subject\u0027s clothes and the new cape. Draw bold, thick black contour lines around the borders of the garments"
      }, {
        "text": ". Fill the clothes and cape with vibrant, flat colors and heavy, stylized black shadows. It should look exactly like a 2D animated"
      }, {
        "text": " cartoon intersecting with a real photo.\"**\n\n### 🔑 Words that trigger the best \"Cel-Shading\" in"
      }, {
        "text": " Nano Banana:\nIf it\u0027s still not giving you those thick enough lines, add these exact trigger words to your"
      }, {
